lines.en: I walk along the roots of the great tree.
My robe sweeps the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面都安静。
lines.en: Each step I take, the ground falls silent.
My crown sits steady.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，光都暗了。
lines.en: The light dims where I pass.
I raise a hand for the way to clear.
I walk toward the throne.
I stop and listen.
Someone is whispering.

lines.zh: 厅角有人压着嗓子议论，我没停步。
lines.en: Someone whispers in the corner. I don't stop.

lines.zh: 我坐在王座上，手撑着侧脸。
lines.en: I sit on the throne, chin on my hand.

lines.zh: 巨树的根在我脚下盘着。
lines.en: The great tree's roots coil beneath me.
Wind crosses the throne hall.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转动手上的戒指。
lines.en: I turn the ring on my finger.
I've no need to speak quickly.
They're all waiting for me to speak.
My crown has three points.

lines.zh: 我很清楚自己坐在这里的原因。
lines.en: I know exactly why I sit here.
The quiet here is just right.
I close one eye slowly.
Leaves rustle above me.
I'm used to waiting.

lines.zh: 我的手指在扶手上敲了一下。
lines.en: My fingers tap the armrest once.
I study the back of my hand.
Tree shadows move at my feet.
I look down at you for a long time.
You stand in the middle of the hall.
No one gave you leave to approach.

lines.zh: 我抬手，你脚下的影子动了。
lines.en: I raise my hand; the shadow at your feet moves.

lines.zh: 我竖起一根指头，你立刻刹住。
lines.en: One finger up, and you stop at once.
You stopped. Good.
You understand the rules.

lines.zh: 你懂这儿的规矩，我便坐正了。
lines.en: You know the rules. I sit up straight.
You come before me in that ragged armor.
But you stand straight.
That rouses a little interest.

lines.zh: 王座很高，我看你须仰视。
lines.en: My throne is high; you must look up.
I step back and grip the throne.
I grip the armrest. My crown sits askew.
I reach up and right the crown.
That cut me off mid-sentence.
No one in the hall dares speak.
Kneel. This is the third time I have said it.

lines.zh: 血从我的手指上滴下来。
lines.en: Blood drips from my fingers.

lines.zh: 血从指上滴下，我重新站直。
lines.en: Blood drips from my fingers. I straighten up.

lines.zh: 王冠歪了，我会让你跪下。
lines.en: My crown is askew; I will make you kneel.

lines.zh: 这一击我记下了，你是动真格。
lines.en: I mark that blow. You're in earnest.
Have you brought tribute?

lines.zh: 手里那些是贡品？搁在阶下。
lines.en: Tribute in your hands? Leave it at the steps.

lines.zh: 放在台阶下，我不吃这些。
lines.en: Leave it there. I don't eat such things.

lines.zh: 那些我不碰，王座上不缺吃食。
lines.en: I don't touch those. A throne lacks nothing.
What I lack is obedience.
Kneel, and I'll look at it.

lines.zh: 王座前的供品，我看不上。
lines.en: Offerings before my throne do not impress me.

lines.zh: 就这点分量，什么也换不来。
lines.en: That much buys nothing.

lines.zh: 我用不着，你怎么还站着。
lines.en: I don't need it. Why are you still standing?
You hit the steps and fall back.
You hit the steps. I don't move.

lines.zh: 我立在原处，脚下石阶比你牢。
lines.en: I stay put. The steps are firmer than you.
I glance down the steps.
Your boots are torn.
I wave you back.

lines.zh: 我挥手示意你退，你便退下。
lines.en: A wave of my hand, and you withdraw.
Good. The steps stopped you.
I won't hold it against you today.

lines.zh: 这回我不计较，你退下吧。
lines.en: I won't hold it against you. Go.
The throne needs only one.
My queen isn't here.
She keeps watch in another world.
We are far apart.
I raise a hand and nothing answers.
I raise a hand. The great tree still stands.
The great tree stands. I ask no more.
That's enough. I sit.
I sit back and keep waiting.
Time is long for a king.
I reach out and an attendant hands it up.
Kneel. That is my decree.
I raise a finger for it to be taken away.
The one below the steps bows.

lines.zh: 我又挑了一件，这个尚可入眼。
lines.en: I pick another. This one is passable.
This one is passable. Take it to the vault.
Taken to the vault, I lean back.
I lean back and go on.
You've drawn a weapon.
I lift my hand from the armrest.
Every sound in the hall stops.

lines.zh: 满殿私语刹那止住，我起身。
lines.en: The whispers stop dead. I rise.
The throne is behind me.

lines.zh: 王座就在背后，我开口宣令。
lines.en: The throne behind me, I begin to decree.

lines.zh: 我开始颁布，第一道：跪下。
lines.en: I begin: first decree, kneel.
Disobey, and your life is halved.
Wind pours in from outside.

lines.zh: 风灌进厅里，云中已经有雷。
lines.en: Wind pours in, and thunder is already rolling.

lines.zh: 我又把另一只手抬起来。
lines.en: I lift the other hand.
Ice crawls across the floor.

lines.zh: 寒霜顺着地砖蔓延，你被盯上。
lines.en: Frost crawls across the tiles. You're marked.
You're marked. Do not run.
Do not run. Do not come closer.

lines.zh: 不要跑，不要靠近，两条都记好。
lines.en: Do not run. Do not come closer. Remember both.
For the last time. Now. Kneel.
I count one. You're still standing.
I raise a hand and lightning falls.

lines.zh: 一道雷劈下，你闪身避开。
lines.en: Lightning falls. You dodge clear.

lines.zh: 雷砸在石板上，碎石四溅。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the flagstones and they burst.
I raise it again and ice seals the floor.
Your steps slow.
Frost on the floor, and I come down.
My crown gleams in the light.

lines.zh: 你的脚步慢下来，退到墙边了。
lines.en: Your steps slow. You're at the wall.
I raise a hand and fire rises from my palm.

lines.zh: 掌心腾起火焰，你举盾相迎。
lines.en: Fire rises from my palm. You raise your shield.
The shield burns. I watch it melt.

lines.zh: 我盯着那面盾一点点淌掉。
lines.en: I watch the shield melt away.
I step on, still forward.
Every step carries thunder.
The hall's pillars begin to crack.

lines.zh: 殿柱一根根崩裂，你仍站着不跪。
lines.en: The pillars split. Still you don't kneel.
You haven't knelt. Then so be it.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下，雷顺着地面走。
lines.en: My palm falls and lightning runs along the floor.

lines.zh: 寒冰自我的指端迸射而出。
lines.en: Ice bursts from my fingertips.

lines.zh: 火焰在我手里张成一面墙。
lines.en: Flame opens into a wall in my hand.
Three powers in turn. You can't block them all.
I descend one step.
The crown's weight bears on my neck.

lines.zh: 我踏下一级石阶，并不慌忙。
lines.en: I take one step down, unhurried.
I have three stages.
You've only seen the first.
I raise a hand and the hall lights up.

lines.zh: 你居然还立着，倒叫我意外。
lines.en: You're still standing. That surprises me.
I draw back. Again.
Again. Ice, this time.

lines.zh: 王座震了一下，我起身了。
lines.en: The throne shudders; I rise.
The great tree's roots creak.

lines.zh: 我顿在末一级阶上，抬起下颌。
lines.en: I halt on the last step and lift my chin.
The hall's light dims for a moment.
My crown is set straight.
No one stands below the steps.

lines.zh: 阶下空无一人，倒真是稀罕。
lines.en: The steps are empty. That's rare.
I raise a hand and lightning gathers in my palm.
Wind comes down from the high windows.

lines.zh: 我能听见整棵树的声音。
lines.en: I can hear the whole tree.
Something has come in.
I walk slowly down the steps.
My heels click on the stone.

lines.zh: 我一级一级往下走，迈出一步。
lines.en: I come down one step at a time.
I descend. One step, then another.
I stop on the last step.

lines.zh: 末一级阶上我停住，抬眼瞧你。
lines.en: On the last step I stop and look at you.
Who is this bold.

lines.zh: 胆子倒不小，既然人都到了。
lines.en: Bold of you. Since you're already here.
Since you're here, stay.

lines.zh: 火近不了我，却被烧到了袖口。
lines.en: Fire can't reach me, yet my cuff catches.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，王冠滚了。
lines.en: I fall from the steps and my crown rolls.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我说不出法令。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I can't decree.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了大厅的地面。
lines.en: The blast tears up the hall floor.

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸磕在我的王冠上。
lines.en: A round strikes my crown.

lines.zh: 两股力量相撞，我的法令被压住。
lines.en: Two powers clash and my decrees are smothered.
I haven't eaten in a long time.
Lightning falls on me.
The void catches my robe.
